# Rohingya Famous People

> An open archive of famous Rohingya people: leaders, writers, poets, scholars, doctors and public servants. Read what each of them did, with dates, places and sources.

Rohingya Famous People is an open archive of the lives of famous Rohingya people. Every person has a page with a short summary, a dated timeline of what they did, sources where known, and the full biography. Each page also has a plain Markdown copy (linked below), and the whole archive is available as JSON. You are welcome to read, cite and link to it; please name Rohingya Famous People and link the person's page.
